blocks.content: Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

A design token is a named value that represents a single design decision. Instead of writing color: #22C55E directly in a component, you create a token - a named variable like --color-primary - and use the name everywhere.

This matters enormously when you are using an AI coding tool. If you tell Claude Code "use the primary brand color for this button," it needs to know what that means. If your tokens are defined in a Tailwind config, Claude Code can use class names like bg-brand-primary and the color is always correct - automatically.
Here is how SpeedBlip's primary color becomes a Tailwind token:
// tailwind.config.ts extend: { colors: { brand: { primary: '#22C55E', dark: '#16A34A', light: '#DCFCE7', accent: '#14B8A6', } } }
Now bg-brand-primary, text-brand-primary, and border-brand-primary are available everywhere in the codebase. One change in the config updates the whole app.
